description:
Fetch the full record for one PropertyList listing by its reference
code (the human-readable id like 'PLE-12345'). Use this once the
user has settled on a listing from search_properties or
find_properties_by_description and wants details or photos. To
contact the listing agency, use submit_enquiry - direct phone or
email details are not part of the payload.

Works without an API key up to a daily allowance of listings,
counted per IP address, or per account for an app linked to a
PropertyList account; an API key raises that allowance. The free
allowance is for an assistant answering a person's questions:
reading listings in bulk, or showing them on a website, needs MCP
Pro or the agency's website feed. When the day's allowance is used
the result carries `error` and `limits` instead of `property`.

`photos` holds the listing's first photos on the free tier and all
of them with MCP Pro; `photos_total` says how many the listing has.

`location.city` is whatever tier the listing was filed under and
may be a municipality OR a locality inside one. To place a listing
administratively use `location.municipality` (with its INE
municipality_code); it is null, never guessed, when we cannot
resolve it.

Commercial premises (`commercial` true) carry no bedrooms: read
`commercial_facts` (usable area, licence, price per m², a
letting's terms, a traspaso's rent and years left) and `tenure`
(freehold, or traspaso for a sale of the lease and the business).

`location.latitude` / `location.longitude` are present whenever
we hold a real coordinate; the fields are absent otherwise, and
are never 0,0. `location.coordinates_precision` says what the
point is: exact or street is the property itself, approximate is
a pin the agent keeps private, rounded to about 1 km, locality or
administrative_area is an area centroid (accurate to the town,
not the building), unknown is a pin we hold no precision record
for.
name: get_property

buildable_sqm.description: Land only: how many m² may be built on the plot (edificabilidad), when the listing says. Null when it does not.

commercial.description: Commercial premises rather than a home.

commercial_facts.description: Commercial premises only: the facts a buyer or tenant of premises reads first, only those the listing has.

energy_kwh_m2.description: EPC energy consumption in kWh/m² per year.

photos_total.description: How many photos the listing has. `photos` holds the first few on the free tier, all of them with MCP Pro.

price.description: Headline price for the listing's transaction type; read with price_period.

price_period.description: total = sale price, per_month = long-term rent, per_week = holiday rent.

tenure.description: How a commercial sale is sold: freehold, or traspaso (the lease and the business taken over). null for homes and lettings.

title: Get property details
